propositions: prev_snapshot.json currently stores full ACLI payload (27.1 MB at HEAD), consuming 228.1 MB storage / 4.5 MB per day; narrowing to key-set dict {jira_key: {}} reduces HEAD to 19,960 bytes while preserving observable mutation effects.

Computing mutations over prev-only keys in full-payload snapshots emits 973–998 unbound_local create mutations that the call-site filter drops; key-set eliminates these at source without changing Jira-facing behavior.

Key-set prev entries must preserve identical outcomes in check_dual_identity_complete and the differ's local-only/emit-both arms, where {jira_key: {}} entries replace full field bodies and local_state[key] or {} guards require mapping type.

Over 400 real revisions, 218 consecutive pairs had identical key sets (producing byte-identical snapshots with no commit), and mean symmetric difference when keys changed was 1.78 keys; corpus diff over 4 real snapshot pairs showed zero observable mutation difference between full and key-set prev.
